name: Long Context

metrics.description: Share of cases whose buried fact was returned exactly.
The largest tested context whose accuracy still reaches the configured share of the shortest-context baseline. Displayed beside the advertised context, never instead of it.

The longest context this sweep actually probed. A property of the measurement, not of the model: when effective_context_tokens equals it, the model did not fail anywhere the sweep looked, and the figure is a floor rather than a limit.
Retrieval accuracy in the presence of near-miss distractor sentences.
Share of two-fact chains answered correctly when the facts sit far apart.

description: Needle retrieval swept across context length, needle position and distractor volume, plus two-fact chains at distance. Advertised context and effective context are always reported as separate numbers.
